title: ConnectAuthResponse
description: Auth challenge reply envelope; proof is method-specific (core methods: noise-peerid, capability-token).

method.description: MUST match challenge method. Core (documented, not enforced): noise-peerid, capability-token. Reserved name: did.

proof.description: Method-specific proof. For capability-token: object { v, claims, sig } (sig over JCS(claims) only).
